mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to increase borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which is typically associated with economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when UNRATE is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth and low unemployment jointly indicate a strong economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth indicates increased economic activity, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when INDPRO is growing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts growth indicates increased construction activity, which is typically associated with economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not lower when FEDFUNDS is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
